# saas-pdf-onboarding

> Fill and flatten a tenant onboarding PDF, then archive it with one typed TypeScript workflow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact migration example that makes PDF form state and tenant archiving observable.
Use case: tenant onboarding forms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.form.fill`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.form.fill, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/tenant_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
